items.question: Why does the speaker say, "its models include a display for advertisements"?
items.transcript:
Thank you for allowing me the opportunity to speak at this city council meeting. On behalf of the transportation department, I'd like to present a proposal to fund the replacement of all 350 bus-stop shelters in our city. We feel this is a worthwhile investment because the current shelters aren't in good shape. Many of them have cracked glass and broken benches. We want to go with Urban Retreat because its shelters are made of durable materials. While less expensive options are available, its models include a display for advertisements. These shelters could provide the city with a new source of income.
83. Who is the speaker presenting to?
84. What does the speaker say about some existing structures?
85. Why does the speaker say, "its models include a display for advertisements"?
options: To respond to a request for information
To suggest adding to a product line
items.explanation:
Người nói lập luận: 'While less expensive options are available, its models include a display for advertisements. These shelters could provide the city with a new source of income.' (...các mô hình của hãng này bao gồm bảng quảng cáo... mang lại nguồn thu nhập mới). Dùng để biện minh cho mức giá đắt hơn (To justify a cost).

items.question: What does the speaker imply when she says, "we have such a large group today"?
items.transcript:
Welcome to the culinary tour of downtown Springfield. Today, you'll taste a variety of local foods. Normally I'd start by taking you inside Zelda's Bakery to try one of their famous corn muffins, but we have such a large group today. Instead, we're going to head directly to the open-air market. There you'll find a wide selection of the homemade breads, jams, and pastries that we're noted for. After that, we'll head to the original Springfield cornmill, which is still in use today. And remember to keep your tour ticket. It's good for one free entry at the local museum.
77. What is the focus of a tour?
78. What does the speaker imply when she says, "we have such a large group today"?
79. What will a ticket allow the listeners to do?
options: She is happy about the popularity of a tour.
She will need to use a microphone.
An additional tour guide is needed.
A shop is not big enough for everyone.
items.explanation: Người hướng dẫn nói: 'Normally I'd start by taking you inside Zelda's Bakery... but we have such a large group today. Instead, we're going to head directly to the open-air market.' (Thông thường tôi sẽ đưa bạn vào Tiệm bánh Zelda... nhưng hôm nay nhóm chúng ta rất đông. Thay vào đó, chúng ta sẽ đi thẳng ra chợ ngoài trời). Ý nói cửa hàng quá nhỏ không chứa đủ mọi người (A shop is not big enough for everyone).

items.question: What does the speaker mean when he says, "We have a lot of work to do"?

It's clear that consumers are no longer interested in the types of toys and games we've been producing. My guess is that people are getting tired of noisy, blinking electronics. We have a lot of work to do. There's a new trend toward outdoor toys and games, where people can be physically active. I've already come up with some prototypes of new games. I brought a few of them, and now I'll show you how they work.

I'd like to pay for national certification for all of our installation techs, which will greatly improve our quality. Let's not forget that the Business Council's yearly ratings will be published soon. In addition, we can attract new customers by offering 25 percent off the installation charge. options: Yes—and it's been the worst at the kind of stores that sell unique items like antiques and jewelry. These items have always been purchased at brick-and-mortar stores but are now being purchased mostly online.

I think they do, especially if we make a point of organizing live community activities downtown, such as concerts or festivals. When people walk around town, they are likely to browse at stores—and make purchases.

So, do those stores have a future?

Người phụ nữ cho biết tình trạng mua sắm suy giảm tồi tệ nhất ở các cửa hàng bán đồ độc đáo (đồ cổ, trang sức), lý do là vì những món đồ này hiện "are now being purchased mostly online" (chủ yếu được mua trực tuyến).
